note: Set B binds the first-floor elevation correctly (2'-4" above grade level 0") and captures several important A5/A3 facts Set A misses entirely: the 6" O.C. nail spacing, 3" wood lag screw with washer, continuous sealant each side of framing, and 7/16" plate hole diameter. Set A invents a quote ("Detail A3: 3/4\" = 1'-0\" DECK MODULE TO CONNECTION"), misreads the detail callout as a value ("8 8D"), converts 1'-4" to an unsupported 1.33 ft bound to the wrong detail, and attributes the A1 module dimension 8'-0" to the A3 connection. Set B's main faults are four dimension strings (1'-4 3/4", 1'-4", 1'-3 1/4", 8'-0") misbound to RAILING ATTACHMENT/deck connection when they belong to the A1 typ. deck module, plus two trivial tautological claims and an inferred scaffold-footing-to-frame connection. Both sets are heavily redundant on the 2"x8" frame/joist and 3/8"x4" hex bolt, but B is the more faithful set overall.
